claims.claim: Amendment 13 (in force 14 August 2025) requires immediate notification of a serious security incident to the PPA (the law says 'immediately', not a fixed 72-hour clock), mandates a DPO for public bodies, data brokers (over 10,000 individuals), large-scale especially-sensitive-data processors, and systematic large-scale monitoring, and introduced statutory damages up to NIS 100,000 / 100,000 ש"ח without proof of harm. Database registration is no longer the primary control.
claims.raw_snippet: the controller must immediately notify the PPA and report the measures taken following the incident ... statutory damages of up to NIS 100,000 / 100,000 ש"ח without proof of harm

claims.claim: Wiz was acquired by Google for ~$32B (closed 11 March 2026, now under Google Cloud Security). CyberArk was acquired by Palo Alto Networks for ~$25B (closed 11 February 2026). MITRE ATT&CK v18 released 28 October 2025. Check Point renamed Quantum SASE to Harmony SASE and Horizon Playblocks to Infinity Playblocks. INCD ICDM 2.0 (2021) maps to NIST CSF 1.1 + SP 800-53 r5; National Cyber Security Strategy updated February 2025.
claims.raw_snippet: Google completed its $32 billion acquisition of Wiz
